points.title: Write transfer completed without error
points.condition: o_apb_pready high for a transfer whose Setup was a write, with o_apb_pslverr low.

points.title: Read transfer completed without error
points.condition: o_apb_pready high for a read transfer with o_apb_pslverr low.

points.title: Write transfer completed with error
points.condition: o_apb_pready high for a write with o_apb_pslverr high.

points.title: Read transfer completed with error
points.condition: o_apb_pready high for a read with o_apb_pslverr high.

points.title: Back-to-back Setup after PREADY
points.condition: Setup cycle (psel high, penable low) in the cycle right after o_apb_pready was high.

points.title: Back-to-back Setup with changed operation
points.condition: Back-to-back Setup whose pwrite differs from the previous transfer's operation.

points.title: Setup after idle gap
points.condition: Setup cycle with no transfer in progress after at least 4 idle requester cycles.

points.title: First Setup after reset release
points.condition: First Setup cycle after reset release on the requester side.

points.title: Long requester Access, 8+ wait cycles
points.condition: o_apb_pready high after at least 8 Access cycles with PREADY low.

points.title: Very long requester Access, 32+ wait cycles
points.condition: o_apb_pready high after at least 32 Access cycles with PREADY low.

points.title: Write with all strobes
points.condition: Write Setup with all pstrb bits set.

points.title: Write with partial strobes
points.condition: Write Setup with pstrb nonzero but not all ones.

points.title: Write with zero strobes
points.condition: Write Setup with pstrb all zero.

points.title: Read with nonzero PSTRB
points.condition: Read Setup with pstrb nonzero.

points.title: PPROT zero
points.condition: Setup with pprot equal to 0.

points.title: PPROT seven
points.condition: Setup with pprot equal to 7.

points.title: PPROT mixed
points.condition: Setup with pprot neither 0 nor 7.

points.title: Address zero
points.condition: Setup with paddr all zero.

points.title: Address all ones
points.condition: Setup with paddr all ones (maximum).

points.title: Unaligned address
points.condition: Setup with a byte address whose two low bits are not zero.

points.title: Write data all ones
points.condition: Write Setup with pwdata all ones.

points.title: Read data all ones returned
points.condition: o_apb_pready for a read with o_apb_prdata all ones.

points.title: Read error with data forwarded
points.condition: o_apb_pready for a read with o_apb_pslverr high and nonzero o_apb_prdata.

points.title: Clean transfer after an error
points.condition: o_apb_pready with o_apb_pslverr low for a transfer following a transfer that completed with error.

points.title: Requester changes fields during Access
points.condition: During an Access cycle before PREADY, paddr or pwdata differs from the previous cycle.

points.title: Reset released after transfer lost in mst domain
points.condition: First mst clock cycle with reset released after a reset that hit while a requester transfer was in flight.

points.title: Mst domain active while slv in reset
points.condition: Rising i_clk_mst edge with i_rst_n_mst high and i_rst_n_slv low (staggered release).

points.title: APB5 wake-up before PSEL
points.condition: APB5 Setup where i_apb_pwakeup was already high in the cycle before psel rose.

points.title: APB5 Setup without wake-up
points.condition: APB5 Setup with i_apb_pwakeup low.

points.title: APB5 nonzero PAUSER
points.condition: APB5 Setup with nonzero i_apb_pauser.

points.title: APB5 write with nonzero PWUSER
points.condition: APB5 write Setup with nonzero i_apb_pwuser.

points.title: APB5 read with nonzero PRUSER
points.condition: APB5 read PREADY with nonzero o_apb_pruser.

points.title: APB5 nonzero PBUSER
points.condition: APB5 PREADY with nonzero o_apb_pbuser.

points.title: Completer-side write Setup
points.condition: o_apb_psel high, o_apb_penable low, o_apb_pwrite high.

points.title: Completer-side read Setup
points.condition: o_apb_psel high, o_apb_penable low, o_apb_pwrite low.

points.title: Completer transfer with zero wait states
points.condition: Completer Access with i_apb_pready high in the first Access cycle.

points.title: Completer back-pressure 4+ cycles
points.condition: Completer Access cycle with i_apb_pready low and at least 3 earlier wait cycles in this transfer.

points.title: Completer completion after 16+ waits
points.condition: i_apb_pready high in Access after at least 16 wait cycles.

points.title: Completer completion with PSLVERR
points.condition: o_apb_psel, o_apb_penable, i_apb_pready and i_apb_pslverr all high.

points.title: Reset released after transfer lost in slv domain
points.condition: First slv clock cycle with reset released after a reset that hit while o_apb_psel was high.
